svg.title: MONOLITH VS MICROSERVICES: sketchnote
svg.text: Splitting an app into services is an organisational decision with
In-process calls and one transaction, or independent deploys
and scaling at the cost of network calls and sagas.
sidecars handle discovery, load balancing, retries, mTLS, metrics
Instances register and heartbeat; callers look them up;
sidecars handle retries, timeouts, mTLS and metrics.
A team must deploy on its own schedule
Events for side effects, sync only when
"I would start as a modular monolith with
Postgres. The one thing I split out on day one is
transcoding, because it needs GPUs and scales
with uploads. Module boundaries become service
